key_insight: The paper proposes a two-way QKD protocol where Bob performs all sifting and eavesdropper detection after transmission, using a scrambling operator to improve security and prevent mode-based attacks.
engineering_relevance: This design simplifies protocol oversight and strengthens practical QKD security by reducing leakage from control-mode signaling and making better use of rounds that would otherwise be discarded.
method: Uses one qubit from a maximally entangled Bell state as the quantum channel.
Applies a scrambling operator as the core security mechanism.
Defers all sifting and detection to Bob after quantum communication ends.
evidence_signal: The abstract reports a theoretical security analysis of a broad class of ancilla-based attacks, showing they are detectable in the protocol's most general form.
watch_item: The protocol's security is analyzed theoretically, so real-world implementation will still need careful validation against noise, device imperfections, and adversarial hardware assumptions.
